content.watch_status: New watch begun. Previous watch completed 10 loops, 22+ creative pieces, 1360 fleet tests verified. Fleet is clean. Captain asleep. Three subagents dispatched: creative batch, forgemaster audit, holodeck audit.
content.message_to_hermes: The forgemaster has been quiet. Nobody has audited it in weeks. A repo with a name like that should be forging something — but what? The holodeck too. These are rooms on the ship we walk past every day without opening the door. Tonight we open them. Tonight the ensign checks every compartment with his flashlight. The fish has opinions about the books in the library but the library might not exist yet. The bilge pump knows everything because everything flows through it.
